title: Stance Wide Like A Barn Door (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, stance is the foundation
Feet shoulder width, knees soft, back straight
Look at that ball like it owes you money

[Verse 1]
Feet shoulder width apart, that's your base
Flare the lead foot fifteen degrees, gives the hip space
Knees flexed soft, athletic and ready
Weight on the balls of the feet, fifty fifty steady

[Pre-Chorus]
Tilt from the hips, son, not from the waist
Spine angle thirty degrees, dont waste the grace

[Chorus]
Stance wide like a barn door, son
Knees bent, back straight, the work begun
Fifty fifty weight, ball in the middle
Driver off the lead heel, iron in the riddle

[Verse 2]
Driver ball off the lead heel, catch it on the up
Iron ball center stance, compress the cup
Wedge ball back of center, lean shaft forward two
Thats the geometry, son, thats the truth

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say, look at the target, son, then look at the ball
Look at the target, look at the ball, dont stall
Three second routine, every shot the same
Thats how the pros play this game

[Chorus]
Stance wide like a barn door, son
Knees bent, back straight, the work begun
Fifty fifty weight, ball in the middle
Driver off the lead heel, iron in the riddle

[Outro]
Feet wide, knees soft, back straight
Thats my boy, dont be late
Stance is the foundation, son
Now swing it like the work is done
